translations.web: Then the nations attacked him on every side from the provinces. They spread their net over him. He was taken in their pit.
translations.bsb: Then the nations set out against him from the provinces on every side. They spread their net over him; he was trapped in their pit.
translations.kjv: Then the nations set against him on every side from the provinces, and spread their net over him: he was taken in their pit.
translations.asv: Then the nations set against him on every side from the provinces; and they spread their net over him; he was taken in their pit.
